senses.gloss:
n. (-लं)
The root of a fragrant grass, used in India for taties or screens against the hot winds, commonly called Kas kas, (Andropogon muricatum.)
E.
अ like, as it were, and मृणाल a fibrous root; also मृणाल.

n. (-तं)
1 The food of the gods, Ambrosia or Nectar.
2 Water.
3 Butter, rice, &c. the residue of a sacrifice.
4 Oiled butter or ghee.
5 Unsolicited alms.
6 Boiled rice.
7 Food.
8 Wealth, property.
9 Gold.
10 Buttermilk.
11 Any thing sweet, a sweetmeat.
12 Milk.
13 Poison.
14 A drug or medicament.
15 Quicksilver.
16 Final emancipation.
m. (-तः)
1 A god, an immortal.
2 DHANVANTARI, the physician of the gods.
f. (-ता)
1 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.)
2 The yellow sort, (Terminalia citrina.)
3 Another plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
4 Long pepper.
5 Holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)
6 Spirituous liquor. It also occurs amongst the synonyms of several plants besides those enumerated.
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Beloved, desired.
2 Beautiful.
3 Immortal, imperishable. []
E.
अ neg. मृङ to die, and क्त affix; what is immortal, or what makes so; what supports life, &c.

m. (-ण्डः)
A vessel of nectar.
E.
अमृत and कुण्ड a hole.

f. (-ता)
Immortality.
E.
अमृत and तल् affix; also with त्व, अमृतत्वं.

f. (-णी)
Moonlight.
E.
अमृत, and तरङ्गिणी a sea.

m. (-तिः)
The moon.
E.
अमृत ambrosia, and दीधिति a ray.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Shedding ambrosia.
E.
अमृत, and द्रव dropping.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Shedding or distilling ambrosia.
E.
अमृत, and धारा a drop.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Drinking ambrosia.
m. (-पः)
A deity.
E.
अमृत, and प who drinks.

m. (-सः)
Nectar, ambrosia.
E.
अमृत, and रस juice.

m. (-र्षः)
A fall of ambrosia from heaven.
E.
अमृत, and वर्ष rain.

f. (-ल्ली)
A species of moonseed, (Menispermum glabrum.) See गुडूची.
E.
अमृत, and वल्ली a pedicle; the plant flourishing for a long time.

m. (-जः)
Raw sugar, molasses.
E.
अमृत ambrosia, सार essence, and ज produced.

m. (-सूः)
The moon, as the producer of ambrosia.
f. (-सूः)
A Mātṛ or a divine mother.
E.
अमृत the ambrosia, and सू who brings forth; from सूड् to bear, and क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-स्रुत्)
Shedding ambrosia.
E.
अमृत, स्रु to distil, क्विप् aff.

m. (-रः)
A horse.
E.
अमृत, and सोदर brother: born with nectar at the churning of the ocean.

m. (-न्धाः)
A deity.
E.
अमृत, and अन्धस् food; whose food is ambrosia.

m. (-लः)
The fruit of the Trichosanthes.
E.
अमृता, and फल fruit.

m. (-नः)
A deity.
E.
as before, अशन eating.

n. (-ङ्गः)
A collyrium, extracted from the Amomum anthoriza. See कर्परी.

m. (-णः)
A name of GARUḌA, the bird of VIṢṆU.
E.
अमृत, हृ to convey, with आङ् prefixed, and ल्युट् affix; GARUḌA having upon one occasion stolen the Amṛta.

f. (-न्ना)
A fly.
E.
अमृत, and उत्पन्न born.

m. (-वः)
A kind of collyrium. See अमृतासङ्ग.
E.
अमृत, and उद्भव born.

f. (-त्तिः)
A drinking vessel.

f. (-त्युः)
Immortality.
E.
अ neg. मृत्यु death.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Wiped, rubbed.
E.
आङ् before मृज to wipe, क्त aff.
